categories.main_business_segments: Cloudwalk Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the artificial intelligence sector, focusing on providing efficient human-machine collaborative operating systems and AI industry solutions. Its business segments include smart governance, smart finance, smart transportation, smart commerce, and general AI applications. The company develops AI platforms, AIoT devices, and customized AI solutions for various industries such as finance, government, transportation, manufacturing, and retail.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include multi-modal large models, human-machine collaborative operating systems (CWOS), AIoT devices, and advanced biometric recognition technologies such as face recognition, voice recognition, and multi-factor biometric authentication. It employs self-supervised pre-training, contrastive learning, and transformer-based architectures for AI model development. Production methods emphasize software development, AI algorithm optimization, and integration with heterogeneous hardware platforms including CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs from various vendors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cloudwalk serves primarily government agencies, financial institutions (including over 100 banks such as major state-owned banks), airports, and large enterprises. Its solutions target vertical industries like smart governance, smart finance, smart transportation, smart commerce, and emerging AI sectors. The company’s products are widely used in public security, financial risk control, airport security, smart city management, and retail environments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with key offices and R&D centers in Guangzhou, Shanghai, Chongqing, Suzhou, Chengdu, and Wuhu. It also has subsidiaries in Singapore and other Chinese cities. Its client base and project deployments cover numerous provinces and major cities across China, including service to nine of China’s top ten airports.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cloudwalk operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI supply chain, focusing on AI software platform development, AIoT device integration, and providing end-to-end AI solutions and services. It collaborates with hardware suppliers for AIoT components and integrates third-party software and hardware products to deliver comprehensive AI solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing its human-machine collaborative operating system and multi-modal AI large models, emphasizing AI platformization and scenario-based applications. It prioritizes R&D in AI core technologies such as multi-modal perception, knowledge reasoning, and intelligent business workflows. Cloudwalk invests heavily in AI algorithm innovation, AIoT hardware development, and industry-specific AI model customization, aiming to deepen AI integration with real economy sectors and build an open AI ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Cloudwalk generates revenue primarily through direct sales of software products including operating systems, core components, and application software, as well as AI solutions combining software and AIoT hardware. It also earns income from technical services such as cloud-based SaaS offerings, risk control services with profit sharing, and intelligent operation and maintenance services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct contracts with government and enterprise clients, supplemented by limited reseller channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cloudwalk is positioned as a leading AI enterprise in China, recognized for its advanced AI technologies and comprehensive industry solutions. It competes with other domestic AI platform providers and faces challenges from large equipment manufacturers and internet companies integrating AI. The company holds a strong market position in biometric recognition and AI large models, with accolades such as top rankings in global AI model evaluations and numerous industry awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Cloudwalk reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 397.7 million, a 36.7% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 695.7 million, reflecting an ongoing unprofitable status. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 1.98 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 1.12 billion. Despite short-term financial pressures, Cloudwalk maintains substantial R&D investment exceeding 119% of revenue, indicating a growth-oriented profile focused on technology development and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cloudwalk emphasizes its unique human-machine collaborative operating system that enables natural interaction and efficient cooperation between humans and AI. Its multi-modal large models and proprietary biometric technologies provide high accuracy and robustness across diverse applications. The company differentiates itself through deep vertical industry expertise, comprehensive AI solutions integrating software and hardware, and a strong commitment to ethical AI development and data security, delivering tailored, scalable, and secure AI capabilities to clients.
